layout.$description: Page layout from the Figma Page Padding, Section Padding, Container and Max Width variables.

padding-section-large.$description: Vertical padding of a large page section.

padding-section-medium.$description: Vertical padding of a medium page section, e.g. the Footer (ADR-0020).

container-large.$description: Maximum width of a section container.

max-width-xlarge.$description: Maximum width of the event list. Not yet a Figma variable (ADR-0021).

max-width-large.$description: Maximum width of a section title block.
